name: Glaucous-Codex
description: Bare rock from pole to pole, shaded in grays, ox-blood reds, and pale magnesium white. The regolith records four billion years of bombardment, scarred through by magnetic pole anomalies near the terminator.
Vacuum carries no sound at all; the loudest thing on this world is your own pulse inside the suit.
The colonists of the buried megastructure kept meticulous logs right up to the final entry, which is a shopping list. Rescue charters still quote the coordinates, and still decline the contract.
The charts mark this world in cautious amber. Those who ignore the marking tend to come back rich, changed, or not at all.
